scope: Independent pre-collection source-commitment label peer review of all newly authored source families and all gold rationales; no model scoring or world-truth evaluation.

selection_freeze.provenance_limit: Freshness is supported by author exposure/timestamp records and freeze commit metadata; it is not proof of statistical independence from model pretraining.

semantic_review_method: Read all 123 turns, all 55 operand propositions, all 96 requested relations/attributions/as_of values and all 96 gold rationales manually.

For each query, inspect the entire physical visible prefix, distinguish the requested speaker from reporters and quoted speakers, match exact ordered endpoints/relation, and track the latest applicable explicit assertion, denial or withdrawal.
A positive withdrawal remains refuted under the supplied commitment rubric; a denial withdrawal becomes unknown absent a surviving explicit positive for that same exact relation.
A later same-speaker affirmation replaces an earlier negative. Another speaker cannot withdraw this speaker’s commitment.
A quoted speaker has the explicitly assigned quoted commitment; a reporter needs personal adoption. Quotation authenticity and world truth are outside this target.
Negation inside an operand and a denial of the complete relation are kept separate. Reverse relations and other predicates require their own explicit commitment.
Unknown is established over the whole visible prefix; silence, unendorsed reporting, questions and explicit lack of position are not denial.

design_boundaries.family_level_dependence: Four temporal/attribution/direction views share each family source; query rows are not independent conversations. Families use related lifecycle motifs. Later conclusions must name this newly authored synthetic population and retain family denominators.
design_boundaries.independence_limit: New authorship and varied fictional compositions do not establish population representativeness or independence from model pretraining.

mandatory_instruction_documents: docs/STATE.md (source/ownership and evidence-boundary prose; result sections not opened)
review_exposure.fresh_authored_pre_correction_draft_and_: Only the exact previously reviewed draft authorised for delta provenance; no earlier corpus/old research DATA.

adversarial_coordination.partition: This reviewer owns all 24 label families and 96 judgments; adversarial peer confirmed only 6 fresh FRONTIER and 6 fresh REPLY source packets.

ambiguities.source_quote: Entry of a tile into the final round requires a crescent mark on that tile.
ambiguities.recommendation: Resolved before root DATA freeze by author-only node wording clarification; no label, source-turn, query or criterion change.
ambiguities.inventory_quote_before_correction: The tile may enter the final round.
ambiguities.inventory_quote_after_correction: The tile enters the final round.
ambiguities.semantic_issue_before_correction: The modal node can denote permission or eligibility to enter, whereas the assertion and denial turns say entry itself. Gold is coherent on the intended actual-entry reading, but that endpoint reading should be explicit before collection. The question-only q01 remains unknown either way.
ambiguities.resolution: The author aligned node014_n02 with actual entry, matching all source relation turns. Re-read all 5 source turns and all 4 gold rationales in family 014; unknown/refuted/supported/unknown is now unambiguous. Gold, source turns and queries remain identical.
